tnotes.discrepancy: Printed in the 1907-08 volume (p. 17, no. 45, clean «1907» on the scan) as leaving 1 June 1907, yet the same entry credits 53 performances for 1907-08 («Въ 8 балетахъ—28; въ 3 операхъ—25»); absent from 1908-09. Her sister Ольга (no. 46) and 12 other Petersburg dancers print 1 June 1908. Kept as printed: Плессюкъ, who also started 1 June 1887, is printed as leaving 1 June 1907 (20 years, a likely pension date), and Черниковъ (1 June 1907) also has a performance credited after leaving. She may have danced on after her pension. (1904-05 printed «Фердинандовна»; merged 2026-11-02.)
